root_cause: This is a known, recurring ARM64 ACL-backend flakiness: for the dynamic-shape AvgPool case with range input (1..10,16,8,8), the CPU plugin's executor-selection logic intermittently falls back to the reference (undef) implementation instead of picking the ACL (acl_f32) primitive that the test explicitly requests via its executor hints. The same primType-mismatch symptom has recurred 6 times since 2026-09-11 across unrelated PRs (pattern eb0b94c864ee1a85, previously seen for MVN and other layers), indicating an underlying non-determinism in ACL executor selection/caching on ARM64 rather than anything introduced by this PR. The PR's changed files (CPU HSM import/export) are unrelated to pooling executor selection, confirming this is pre-existing test flakiness unrelated to the PR content.
reproduction_steps: Build the ARM64 cross-compiled CPU plugin and run: ./ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter='*smoke_AvgPool_CPU_4D_NotOptimized*CompareWithRefs*' repeatedly (dynamic-shape range-based AvgPool with ACL executor hint); the failure is intermittent and may not reproduce on every run.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed CPU functional tests job (transient flaky test, unrelated to the PR's changed files)

Investigate ACL executor-selection determinism for dynamic-shape pooling ops in src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/executors (track CVS ticket for the recurring eb0b94c864ee1a85 pattern, now at 6+ occurrences)
Consider temporarily marking this parameterized AvgPool case as disabled/flaky if recurrence continues to block unrelated merge-queue runs
prevention_strategies: Add stricter determinism/retry handling around ACL primitive selection for dynamic-shape pooling tests, or isolate ACL-specific executor selection logic with explicit logging to capture why it falls back to undef_f32 under certain input ranges.
historical_context: Recurring pattern eb0b94c864ee1a85 ('primType is unexpected undef_f32 Expected acl_f32') has been seen 6 times since 2026-09-11 (PRs #37783, #37885, #38052, #38528, #38669, #39245), always on ARM64 cross-compilation CPU functional tests, always Flaky Test category with no established fix beyond re-running. This occurrence (PR #39251) is the 7th.
